subject: Television & Streaming
title: Johnny Carson Reinvents Late Night
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Johnny Carson Reinvents Late Night.

hook.text: Johnny Carson hosted The Tonight Show for 30 years. Every night, 15 million Americans fell asleep to his voice.

buildup.text: Carson didn't just tell jokes—he created a nightly ritual. His monologue became America's shared bedtime story.

discovery.text: A single appearance on Carson could launch a career. Comedians got famous overnight from one five-minute set.

twist.text: Carson was painfully shy offscreen. He divorced three times and rarely socialized. The warmth was a performance.

climax.text: When he retired in 1992, 50 million viewers watched. No late-night host has matched his cultural hold since.

punchline.text: America's friendliest man was lonely offstage.

quiz.question: How long did Johnny Carson host The Tonight Show?
